title: AquaTerra in July 2023: {count} drives, trees and Sunday school
description: July 2023 at AquaTerra: {count} drives, eight planting runs, a weekly Sunday school at Pather Sathi, two fundraisers and the fifth Sundarbans project.
lede: In July 2023 AquaTerra ran {count} drives across {placesCount} places, with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts. Eight Grow Green planting drives went through parks, squares and a school. Pather Sathi's Sunday school ran a session every week, and two fundraisers, a football match and a card night, funded the welfare drives.

sections.heading: a weekly Sunday school at Pather Sathi
body: Pather Sathi's Sunday school ran on the same day every week: Learn and Light on July 1, Peace Within on July 8, Wonder Lab on July 15, Tech Time on July 22 and Hearts and Minds on July 29. Learn and Light brought stories, smiles and skills, and Wonder Lab went from fizzing volcanoes to floating eggs.

Two sessions were about computers. Tech Time on July 22 introduced digital literacy, and Ctrl+Create on July 28 taught foundational computer skills in a friendly setting. Peace Within on July 8 was a mental health awareness session, with the title Healthy Minds, Faithful Hearts.

sections.heading: eight planting drives in one month
body: Grow Green carried on from June, starting with Plantation Drive 12.0 on July 1 and running to 19.0 on July 21. Three drives were on July 14: 14.0 at Goltalab, and 15.0 and 16.0 at Gachtala. Drive 17.0 went through Gitanjali and Vivekananda Parks on July 15, and 18.0 went to Shubo Malik Square the same day.

Each drive planted between eighty and a hundred saplings. Drive 12.0 carried the Each One Plant One name, and drive 13.0 was at Calcutta Girls High School on July 5, a school planting in the middle of the run.

sections.heading: two fundraisers, one of them a football match
body: Match with a Mission was a football fundraiser at VS Arena on July 1, with five volunteers. Its theme was goals, grit and giving, and it turned a football match into a night for the welfare work.

Full House, on July 7 at Madhuvan, was an evening of cards, fun and charity. It had the largest team of the month, with twenty volunteers. Both nights help fund AquaTerra's welfare drives, and the money raised goes to those drives.

sections.heading: stories, a women's camp and the Sundarbans
body: Story narration workshops ran in three places. Telling Tales was at Disha Foundation on July 12, Speak the Story was at School on Wheels HUHT on the same day, and Once Upon A Voice was at Ek Tara on July 19.

Empower Her, a woman awareness camp on July 14 with the Woman Wings of the Ahamaddiya Muslim Community, created space for strength, stories and sisterhood, and three volunteers ran it. The Pather Sathi Sunderbans Project on July 29 was the fifth edition, with twelve volunteers, and it deepened the connection with the Sundarbans and its communities.

sections.heading: the stray dog drive keeps going
body: Tails and Treats 18.0 was the July dog feeding drive, on July 1 in Kolkata, with four volunteers. Its summary was about tails, treats and love, and it was the fourth drive in this stretch of the series.
The series had been at 15.0 and 16.0 in May and 17.0 in June, so July's drive carried the same plan to the next month. The drive's own aim was a full belly and a happy day for every dog.

learnings: A weekly slot is easier to keep than a one-off: Pather Sathi's Sunday school ran on the same day of the week all month.
A planting run can move from place to place: eight drives in parks, squares and a school all used the same name and plan.
Fundraisers can be small: a football match with five volunteers and a card night with twenty both ran to fund welfare drives.
Story sessions can run in several places at once: Telling Tales, Speak the Story and Once Upon A Voice all ran in July.

faqs.q: What did AquaTerra do in July 2023?
faqs.a: In July 2023 AquaTerra ran {count} drives across {placesCount} places, with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts. The month had eight Grow Green planting drives, the Pather Sathi Sunday school sessions, two fundraisers, a women's awareness camp, story workshops, a stray dog feeding drive and the fifth Pather Sathi Sundarbans Project.

faqs.q: Where did AquaTerra plant trees in July 2023?
faqs.a: AquaTerra's Grow Green planting drives in July 2023 ran at Goltalab, Gachtala, Gitanjali and Vivekananda Parks, Shubo Malik Square, CB Block Park and Calcutta Girls High School. The run was numbered from 12.0 to 19.0, and each drive planted between eighty and a hundred saplings.

faqs.q: Did AquaTerra run a football fundraiser in 2023?
faqs.a: Yes. Match with a Mission was a football fundraiser at VS Arena on July 1, 2023, with five volunteers. The money raised goes to AquaTerra's welfare drives. AquaTerra takes no monetary donations and is funded by its own events.

faqs.q: Does AquaTerra run computer workshops for children?
faqs.a: Yes. At Pather Sathi's Sunday school, AquaTerra ran Tech Time on July 22, 2023, a session on digital literacy, and Ctrl+Create on July 28, which introduced foundational computer skills. Both were workshops for children run by student volunteers.
